issues.explanation: This is an ordinary verb plus result complement in 浪花淘尽英雄, so grouping it hides the useful complement 尽.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 淘 (to wash away) and 尽 (completely; result complement).

issues.explanation: In 是非成败转头空, 空 means that things come to nothing or are in vain, not merely “empty.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use “to come to nothing; be in vain.”

issues.explanation: 巨鹿 is only the place name; “native of Julu” belongs to the larger phrase 巨鹿人 and is not the meaning of this segment alone.
In 进山, 进 means “to enter” or “go into,” not primarily “to go forward.”
With 封谞等 as the subject, 下狱 means “to be imprisoned” or “to be sent to prison,” not the active verb “to imprison.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use “to be imprisoned; be sent to prison.”

issues.explanation: This is a compositional expansion verb plus endpoint complement, not a single lexical expression; 至 is useful separately for learners.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 扩 (to expand) and 至 (up to; to).

issues.explanation: This is the ordinary verb-complement phrase 传到, so grouping it hides the useful directional complement 到.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 传 (to pass on; transmit) and 到 (to; reach).
